say:1:1560104001:1.text: Me? I'm here to gain some experience, Magister! Payment in acorns matters little to me.
say:1:1560104001:1.source_cn: 主人，溜溜是来积累社会经验的，不是偷偷来赚橡果的！
say:1:1560104001:1.male: Me? I'm here to gain some experience, Magister! Payment in acorns matters little to me.
say:1:1560104001:1.female: Me? I'm here to gain some experience, Magister! Payment in acorns matters little to me.

say:2:1560104002:1.text: Though a humble post, but don't worry! I perform my duties with care.
say:2:1560104002:1.source_cn: 虽然溜溜是打工仔，但可是很专业的哦！
say:2:1560104002:1.male: Though a humble post, but don't worry! I perform my duties with care.
say:2:1560104002:1.female: Though a humble post, but don't worry! I perform my duties with care.

say:3:1560104003:1.text: Feel free to ask me anything about the guess-off. What was that?
say:3:1560104003:1.source_cn: 南瓜大竞猜的规则可以随意问我！但、但是——
say:3:1560104003:1.male: Feel free to ask me anything about the guess-off. What was that?
say:3:1560104003:1.female: Feel free to ask me anything about the guess-off. What was that?

say:4:1560104004:1.text: The correct answer? No way! I can't give that away. The guess-off needs to run fair! *Squeak*
say:4:1560104004:1.source_cn: 溜溜不会告诉主人正确答案的！要维护公平，吱吱！
say:4:1560104004:1.male: The correct answer? No way! I can't give that away. The guess-off needs to run fair! *Squeak*
say:4:1560104004:1.female: The correct answer? No way! I can't give that away. The guess-off needs to run fair! *Squeak*
